_meta.title: Permanent Laser Hair Removal in Budapest – Elysion Pro, 12-Month Guarantee | MOSAIC
_meta.description: Permanent hair removal in Budapest with the Elysion Pro laser (1023 Bécsi út 2.): pay for only 6 of 8 sessions, 12-month guarantee, 20% off your first treatment, maintenance treatments at half price forever.

szoveg.Lézeres szőrtelenítés 12 hónap garanciáv: Laser hair removal with a 12-month guarantee
szoveg.A világ egyik legerősebb diódalézerével,: With the Elysion Pro, one of the most powerful diode lasers in the world. No prepayment of hundreds of thousands: you pay per session, the 4th and 8th sessions are free, and maintenance treatments are half price forever.
You pay per session instead of buying a package.
szoveg.A 8 alkalmas program ára az alkalmanként: The price of the 8-session programme is 6 times the price per session: the 4th and 8th sessions are free.
szoveg.Valódi MOSAIC vendégek fotói: kezelés el: Photos of real MOSAIC guests: before and after treatment.
szoveg.Már 2 alkalom után szőrtelen leszel, a m: You will be hair-free after just 2 sessions; the remaining 6 sessions are only needed for lasting results – and we give you 2 sessions as a gift. That means saving hundreds of thousands of forints.
szoveg.Bérlet helyett alkalmanként fizetsz, nem: You pay per session instead of buying a package, so you don't have to pay a large amount upfront.
szoveg.Ha a 8. kezelés után 12 hónapon belül vi: If the hair grows back within 12 months after the 8th treatment, we remove it free of charge.
szoveg.Fenntartó kezelések örökre féláron: Maintenance treatments at half price forever
szoveg.A garancia lejárta után a fenntartó keze: After the guarantee expires, you can have maintenance treatments at a 50% discount forever.
szoveg.Szabó Brigitta vagyok, több mint 3 éve f: I'm Brigitta Szabó, and I have been doing laser hair removal for more than 3 years. I also have several years of cosmetic and healthcare experience, so I don't look at skin only from a cosmetic point of view: I know how it works and how it reacts, and I know what to pay attention to during a treatment.
szoveg.Évek óta csak az Elysion Pro-val dolgozo: For years I have worked only with the Elysion Pro, because it is effective, comfortable and safe. It is a medical diode laser, one of the most powerful on the market (3,500 W), so it reaches the hair follicles more effectively than weaker machines. The built-in Crystal Freeze system cools the skin to 5 °C throughout the treatment, so it can be used safely on most skin types.
szoveg.Minden kezelés előtt megnézem a bőr- és: Before every treatment I check your skin and hair type, we go through what to expect, and I adjust the settings to you. If you are unsure, come in for a free consultation.
szoveg.A kezeléssel kapcsolatban érdekelhet: You might also be interested in
szoveg.A legtöbb vendégünk csak kellemes hűvöss: Most of our guests feel only a pleasant coolness and a slight tingling. The Elysion Pro's built-in Crystal Freeze system cools the skin to 5 °C throughout the treatment, which numbs the surface while the laser works deep inside.
szoveg.A lézer csak a növekedési (aktív) fázisb: The laser only reaches hairs in the growth (active) phase, and hairs are not all in this phase at the same time. That is why we repeat the treatments in line with the hair growth cycle: our programme is at most 8 sessions, but if fewer are enough, you pay for fewer.
szoveg.A lézer a szőrtüszőt károsítja, ezért a: The laser damages the hair follicle, so treated follicles no longer produce hair: this is the “permanent” result you reach by the end of the programme. Over the years, hormonal changes can wake up dormant follicles and new hairs may appear. That is why there is the 12-month guarantee (if the hair grows back by then, we remove it free of charge), followed by maintenance treatments at half price forever.
szoveg.Egy kezelés a területtől függően kb. 30–: Depending on the area, one treatment takes about 30–60 minutes (full legs about 60 minutes). The first session is 60 minutes: after the assessment we start the treatment right away.
szoveg.A program legfeljebb 8 alkalomból áll, m: The programme consists of at most 8 sessions, because the laser only reaches hairs in the growth phase, and these do not “mature” all at once. At the first treatment we estimate how many sessions you will need based on your skin and hair type, and you get a fixed price for it that does not change. If fewer are enough, you pay for fewer. If the hair grows back within 12 months after the 8th treatment, we remove it free of charge.
szoveg.Mitől más az Elysion Pro?: What makes the Elysion Pro different?
szoveg.Az Elysion Pro orvosi diódalézer, az egy: The Elysion Pro is a medical diode laser, one of the most powerful on the market (3,500 W), so it reaches the hair follicles more effectively than weaker machines. The cooling head protects the skin, so the treatment is comfortable and can be used safely on most skin types.
szoveg.Az árak egy kezelésre (alkalomra) vonatk: Prices are per treatment (session). In the 8-session programme the 4th and 8th sessions are free, so you pay for only 6 sessions.

szoveg.Minden bőrtípusra alkalmas a kezelés?: Is the treatment suitable for all skin types?
szoveg.A diódalézer a legtöbb bőrtípuson bizton: The diode laser can be used safely on most skin types. At the first session we determine your skin type using the Fitzpatrick scale and the thickness of your hairs, and set the machine accordingly. The laser is less effective on very light, thin or grey hair: if you are unsure, come to a free consultation and we will check together.
szoveg.Milyen mellékhatásokkal járhat?: What side effects can it have?
szoveg.Kezelés után enyhe bőrpír, melegségérzet: After the treatment, mild redness, a feeling of warmth or sensitivity may occur: this is a natural reaction and usually disappears within 48 hours. If persistent irritation, blistering or an unusual skin symptom appears, please let us know in time.
szoveg.Már az első kezelés után észrevehető a r: Thinning is noticeable after the very first treatment (even 20–30%). The treated hairs gradually fall out within 1–3 weeks after the treatment, and you reach the final result by the end of the 8-session programme.
szoveg.Lehet napozni a kezelések alatt?: Can I sunbathe during the treatments?
szoveg.A kezelés előtti 2 hétben kerüld a napoz: In the 2 weeks before the treatment avoid sunbathing and tanning beds. For 3–5 days after the treatment avoid intense heat and UV radiation (tanning bed, midday sun), and SPF 50+ sunscreen is mandatory on the treated area. If you follow this, you don't have to skip the summer season.
szoveg.A kezelt szőrtüszők nem termelnek többé: Treated hair follicles no longer produce hair. Over the years, hormonal changes can wake up dormant follicles, so after the 12-month guarantee 1 maintenance “reminder” treatment per year may be needed, which you get at half price forever. And you can forget about everyday shaving.
szoveg.Mit kezdjek a szőrrel két kezelés között: What should I do with the hair between two treatments?
szoveg.A kezelések között bármikor borotválkozh: You can shave at any time between treatments, so your skin can stay smooth throughout. The only rule: forget removal from the root (waxing, epilator, tweezers) during the course, because it would pull out the laser's target, the hair follicle.
szoveg.Mi történik az első alkalommal?: What happens at the first session?
szoveg.Az első alkalom 60 perces, és 20% kedvez: The first session lasts 60 minutes and is available with a 20% discount. We determine your skin type and hair thickness, go through the contraindications (e.g. photosensitising medication, hormonal diseases), and then start the first treatment according to your skin type. Finally we estimate how many sessions you will need, and you get a fixed price for it.
szoveg.Hogyan készüljek a kezelésre?: How should I prepare for the treatment?
szoveg.Az időpontod előtt 24 órával borotváld l: Shave the area to be treated 24 hours before your appointment so that the laser energy goes directly into the hair follicle. On the day of the treatment do not use body lotion, oil, deodorant or other cosmetics on the treated area. Do not wax or epilate in the 3–4 weeks before the treatment, because the laser needs the hair follicle. For 24–48 hours after the treatment avoid hot baths, saunas, swimming pools and intense exercise.
szoveg.Intim területen is biztonságos?: Is it safe in the intimate area too?
szoveg.A hűtőfej folyamatosan védi a bőrt, így: The cooling head continuously protects the skin, so the sensitive skin of the intimate areas is not damaged either, and the treatment is carried out by a professional with complete discretion.
szoveg.Ha a 8. kezelés után 12 hónapon belül vi: If the hair grows back within 12 months after the 8th treatment, we remove it for free. The price guarantee comes with it too: the price of the programme is fixed, you pay for only 6 of the 8 sessions, and not upfront but per session.
szoveg.A 12 hónapos garancia lejárta után az év: After the 12-month guarantee expires, you can have the annual maintenance treatments at a 50% discount forever, that is, at half price. You won't necessarily need them, but if a few hairs reappear due to hormonal changes, we treat them quickly and at a discount.
szoveg.Kinek nem javasolt a kezelés?: Who is the treatment not recommended for?
szoveg.várandósság és szoptatás esetén; fényérz: during pregnancy and breastfeeding; when taking photosensitising medication (e.g. some antibiotics, retinoids, antidepressants); in epilepsy; in active cancer (or within 5 years after recovery); with a pacemaker or metal implant in the area; with a tendency to keloids; in severe autoimmune disease (e.g. lupus, vitiligo in the given area).
szoveg.friss leégés vagy napozás után (ha a bőr: after recent sunburn or sunbathing (if the skin is red or sensitive), in case of active infection in the area to be treated (e.g. herpes, fungus, open wound), and if you have waxed or epilated in the past 3–4 weeks.
